text:
deploy-bot: Initiating blue->green rollout to eu-west-1. rollout_id=2026-03-15-rc7. goal: 25% to green, staggered steps.

rene (eng-release): starting canary now. step1=10% for 4m then step2=25%. model-variant=new-model-v2 flag=on

alex (oncall): grabbing the runbook and watching. link: https://confluence/redwood/rollouts/runbook

viv (sre): small uptick in 5xx on eu-west at t+2m, investigating logs. not all traffic should hit green yet.

rene (eng-release): logs from green nodes show model initialization errors:```
[2026-03-15T15:12:07Z] model_init WARN checkpoint mismatch, retrying
[2026-03-15T15:12:09Z] model_init ERR failed to load weights: context canceled
[2026-03-15T15:12:11Z] http 502 upstream timeout
```

tay (netops): seeing mixed edge IPs for api.eu-west-1.ingress:```
$ dig +short api.eu-west-1.redwood-inference.net
52.16.11.100  # old-edge pool
54.77.210.123 # green-edge (unexpected)
```

viv (sre): that green-edge IP is returning 502s and backends referencing the new image. looks like edge cached routing after the canary step.

infra-bot: PagerDuty alarm: SEV2 -> INC-3275 triggered.

pagerduty-bot: Assigned to alex (oncall). :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): oncall ack. immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout 2) disable routing feature flag 3) force remove green IPs 4) assess customer impact 5) rollback if not resolved.

rene (eng-release): pausing via controlplane: `redwoodctl rollout pause --id 2026-03-15-rc7 --region eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-15-rc7 paused by rene (stage: step1)

tay (netops): despite pause, some clients still reach 54.77.210.123 due to edge cache TTL. trying to flush routing cache: `edgectl purge-route api.eu-west-1 --ip 54.77.210.123`

viv (sre): errors climbed to +22% above baseline during peak. we should page SRE immediately. alex, do you want to flip the flag now?

alex (oncall): flip flag first. do it rene.

rene (eng-release): disabling flag via feature service:```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/disable -d '{"flag":"model-routing-v2","scope":"prod"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```

infra-bot: Feature op acknowledged. disabling model-routing-v2 across prod.

rene (eng-release): flag reports as disabled (200).

tay (netops): even after flag off, edge still returns green IP until TTL expiry (~90s). pushing a targeted LB backend weight change: `lb-api set-weight --ip 54.77.210.123 --weight 0 --region eu-west-1`

viv (sre): monitoring. 5xx rate now trending down after LB weight change. current delta +6% vs baseline.

maya (cs): notifying customers | drafting: "We detected degraded responses from eu-west-1 between 15:12-15:22 UTC due to a partial rollout. We're investigating and will update when resolved." sending to affected accounts now.

nik (pm): any data loss or duplicate request concerns?

rene (eng-release): no persistent state changes; ephemeral request-level errors only. clients may have retried. we'll scan logs for idempotency issues.

alex (oncall): if we see sustained errors >5% after 5 more minutes, prepare for rollback. timeline: 5min.

viv (sre): errors back to near-baseline ~3m after LB weight change. tailing traces show most 502s originated from green-edge.

rene (eng-release): going to cancel rollout and redeploy stable image to be safe: ```bash
redwoodctl rollout cancel --id 2026-03-15-rc7 --region eu-west-1 && redwoodctl deploy --image redwood/runtime:2026-03-08-stable --region eu-west-1 --force
```

deploy-bot: Rollout canceled by rene. initiating stable redeploy to eu-west-1.

pagerduty-bot: INC-3275 status update: mitigation in progress, assignee alex (oncall).

tay (netops): green IPs removed from LB rotation; DNS now returns only old-edge IPs. residual TTL expected ~90s.

maya (cs): reaching out to top impacted customers with incident note.

viv (sre): baseline metrics restored ~7min after mitigations. 5xx delta ~+0.3% (noise). latency normal.

alex (oncall): preparing handoff notes. handoff to viv in 30m. summary: "SEV2 INC-3275: Partial traffic leak to green-edge during blue/green canary in eu-west-1 due to edge routing cache TTLs. Actions: rollout paused, feature flag disabled, LB weight zeroed, rollout canceled, stable redeploy initiated. Customer outreach ongoing."

infra-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: new oncall viv (sre) at 2026-03-15T17:00Z

viv (sre): acknowledged. will monitor for 1h then clear incident if stable. scheduling postmortem for 2026-03-16 11:00 UTC.

rene (eng-release): follow-ups: 1) add explicit edge cache invalidation step to rollout playbook 2) gate canary so LB/edge state verification happens before traffic shifts 3) improve model-load telemetry and pre-warm checks 4) add synthetic tests hitting edges post-flag-change

alex (oncall): documenting severity and impact on INC-3275: severity=SEV2, region=eu-west-1, peak-5xx=+22%, affected-customers=several (notable), mitigations=flag-off + lb-weight0 + cancel + stable-redeploy.

maya (cs): will update customers after postmortem with timeline and remediation steps.

alex (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. will publish postmortem draft tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
